sys_app.name: SDLC AI Orchestrator
sys_app.short_description: AI-powered SDLC automation: story uplift, code generation, unit tests, ATF creation
sys_app.description: Automates the transition from User Story to Verified Code. Provides LLM-powered story uplift (INVEST + Gherkin), ServiceNow code generation, Jasmine unit test generation, stakeholder test step generation, and automated ATF test suite creation. Integrates with Anthropic Claude and OpenAI APIs.
